scope: The 7 rows that v5 left UNRESOLVED. The other 48 rows keep their v4 evidence. This is research, not a scan: no source was added, enabled or fetched, no job-listing API was called, and no e-mail was sent.
rules: Owner-machine requests only, with the v5 User-Agent. A 2-second same-host interval was intended, but the second-resolution request log shows some same-host HTTP requests in the same or adjacent second. The log does not establish that the minimum interval was met; this is a recorded pacing deviation, not a claim of compliance.

robots.txt honoured with an RFC 9309 matcher: 4xx = unavailable (allowed), 5xx or network/TLS failure = disallow all. Redirects are never followed automatically; each hop is logged, and more than five hops is treated conservatively as disallow all.

No cookie is kept or replayed. No login, apply path, CAPTCHA or bot-protection bypass. A challenge or rejection on a requested content page ends attempts on that path; the log includes separately permitted public pages on the same host, which were read only when served normally. A TLS reset or certificate error makes the affected host unreadable. Nothing was retried with a different client or remote reader. A 4xx response to robots.txt, even if it is a challenge page, is treated as robots unavailable under the separately stated RFC 9309 rule; a normally served content page may then be read without bypassing the challenge.
Officialness: only the employer's own domain, or a destination linked or redirected to from it, counts. ATS branding and company profiles alone stay unverified leads.

A MANUAL_LINK needs a jobs or application route published on the employer's own site and a verified reason ASTRA cannot read the postings. The destination's listings need not have been seen (as for SSMC in v3), and the row never counts as coverage or as an open posting.
'Supported feed' means an ASTRA adapter it may use (Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby). SmartRecruiters stays an Owner decision.
counts_note: v5 had 0 / 48 / 7. PureHealth and ADPHC now have a jobs or application route published on their own sites. The other five stay UNRESOLVED.
not_claimed: No posting is claimed open, and no row is covered automatically.
A MANUAL_LINK is a link for the user to open; ASTRA does not read it.
The Owner's controlled scan (run 107) of nine configured board sources neither covers nor validates any of these seven employers.

rows.platform: LinkedIn Jobs search (third-party), filtered by seven LinkedIn company IDs chosen by the employer.
rows.why_astra_cannot_read: LinkedIn's robots.txt disallows every path for this client, including /jobs/search/. The destination was not requested.
rows.evidence: PureHealth's homepage served normally (HTTP 200, no challenge) at 2026-09-27T13:41:17Z and again at 13:43:05Z. Its main-menu and footer 'Careers' links and /careers/ (HTTP 301) go to the LinkedIn company profile; a separate 'Careers' link on the same page goes to the LinkedIn jobs search above. The employer's own page establishes that link.
caveats: The destination's listings were not seen, and the entities behind the seven company IDs were not verified.
The link, as published, is not UAE-filtered (geoId 92000000) and carries LinkedIn session-style parameters, so it may change without notice.
LinkedIn may ask a browser user to sign in.
rows.not_a_route: The homepage presents TalentOne (talentone.ae) as a separate human-resource-management portfolio company. talentone.ae's own 'Careers' link goes to an Oracle Candidate Experience site (CX_6007). That is TalentOne's route, not a PureHealth route, and it is not used here.

rows.blocker: www.zu.ac.ae and zu.ac.ae both reset the TLS connection at robots.txt (WinError 10054), so no ZU page may be fetched and none can show a forward link.
rows.owner_browser_check: Open https://www.zu.ac.ae/main/en/careers/ and confirm where its staff-vacancies link goes.

rows.application_route: The official FAQ answers 'How can I apply for vacancies at ADPHC?' with 'You can email your CV to HR@adphc.gov.ae' (Arabic page: Hr@adphc.gov.ae).
rows.platform: No readable job board. Application guidance is a CV sent by e-mail, as for EWEC.
rows.why_astra_cannot_read: /en/Careers is allowed by robots.txt but returns a web-application-firewall 'Request Rejected' page (not bypassed). The only verified route is e-mail application guidance; there is no board or feed to read.
rows.evidence: The FAQ page (HTTP 200, allowed by robots.txt, which disallows only /sitecore) is a Sitecore SXA search shell. Its answers load from the page's own declared endpoint, /en/sxa/search/results/ and /ar-AE/sxa/search/results/, which returned the answer above in both languages at 2026-09-27T13:44:54-55Z. v5 read only the shell, so it saw no answer.
caveats: This is application guidance, not evidence of any current vacancy. No e-mail was sent.
What /en/Careers lists, if anything, is unknown.
An unrelated FAQ answer on the same site also mentions a CV; it is recorded in the request log and not used.

rows.official_link_observed: DoH's homepage (https://www.doh.gov.ae/en/) still links 'Careers' to an Oracle E-Business Suite page on aderp.abudhabi.ae.
rows.blocker: aderp.abudhabi.ae still fails TLS verification ('certificate has expired'). The presented certificate (GlobalSign RSA OV SSL CA 2018) expired on 2025-09-09. Its robots.txt is unreadable, nothing there is fetched, and a browser would warn. /en/careers on doh.gov.ae redirects to a 404 page.
rows.owner_browser_check: Only useful after DoH renews the certificate; ASTRA will not offer a link that raises a certificate warning.

rows.blocker: robots.txt, /en/about-us/careers and the /en homepage all return a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' challenge (HTTP 403), which was not bypassed.
rows.owner_browser_check: Open https://www.emiratesislamic.ae/en/about-us/careers and confirm where its 'View Vacancies' link goes.

rows.blocker: robots.txt on www.hct.ac.ae and hct.ac.ae redirects /robots.txt -> /robots.txt/ -> /robots.txt// and then to itself. The first hops set a cookie, which was not kept. After more than five hops it is treated as disallow all, so no HCT page is fetched.
rows.protocol_note: RFC 9309 section 2.3.1.2 permits (MAY) treating more than five redirects as 'unavailable', which would allow access. This research keeps the conservative reading used in v4 and v5; changing it is an Owner decision.
rows.owner_browser_check: Open https://hct.ac.ae/en/careers/ and confirm where its 'Current Vacancies' link goes.

rows.blocker: du.ae's robots.txt applies 'Disallow: /' to all agents, so neither /about-us/careers nor /corporate/sitemap was requested.
rows.owner_browser_check: Open du's careers page and confirm where its 'Join Us' link goes.
